shared_elements: quadruped with head and legs rendered laterally
low-relief carving with outlined bodies against a plain ground
justification: Both show profile animals carved in low relief arranged in horizontal registers, with a plant/tree element included, which is a generic correspondence. A depicts a narrative procession of human figures leading horned rams beside a large detailed tree with a floral border, while B shows no humans at all but rows of schematic predator/quadruped heads, a bird-like figure, and abstract signs; the relationships (men herding animals vs. isolated stacked creatures) and the naturalistic versus highly schematic conventions differ fundamentally.
